description: This file defines an enumeration 'ProtocolMessageType' that lists various WebSocket protocol message types for controlling event and message emission in a WebSocket service, including associated properties and methods.

classes.name: ProtocolMessageType
classes.description: Enumeration of WebSocket protocol message types with associated identifiers and streaming types, providing methods for identification and retrieval of streaming type.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for this protocol message type.

methods.name: isStartSending
methods.description: Checks if the message type indicates a start streaming command.

methods.name: getStreamingTypeOrThrow
methods.description: Returns the associated streaming type if available, throws exception otherwise.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string identifier of the message type.
